recipes.label: Purge the army
recipes.startdescription:
You are certain there are spies infiltrated among your men. For the final victory, it is better to kill a thousand by mistake than to let one go!

[This will randomly cause three of your comrades to die, but will immediately lower the infiltration level. Alternatively, you may choose a gentler but slower approach to reduce infiltration.]
